title: BAC validator parity manifest
description: Wire-stable contract between the C++ validator (this plugin) and the TypeScript port (vscode-bac LSP). Both ports load every fixture and assert the same expected_error_codes outcome.

path.description: Path relative to the plugin root, e.g. Tests/Corpus/Validate_Foo.bac.

passes.description: Pass set the validator must run. AstOnly is portable across both ports; AstOnly+Identifiers needs UE reflection (C++ side runs it; TS port currently runs the AstOnly subset and skips identifier-resolved counts).

expected_error_codes.description: Map of diagnostic code → exact expected count of error-severity diagnostics. A count of 0 asserts the code does NOT appear (positive-case fixtures). Non-listed codes are unconstrained.
